summary: Bulk launch: POST JSON listing unified job templates (job templates, project updates) to /api/v2/bulk/job_launch; the user needs launch permission on all of them, an error explains failures, and OPTIONS returns the schema.
questions: How do I launch many jobs at once with the AAP API?
What permissions are needed for bulk job launch?

answer_card.title: Bulk job launch API
answer_card.answer_md: Send JSON to `POST /api/v2/bulk/job_launch` listing the unified job templates (for example job templates and project updates) to start. The user must be allowed to launch every one, otherwise an error explains what failed. Send `OPTIONS` to the same endpoint to see the request schema.
